date_inferred_from: Entered at the foot of leaf 172 verso; the next heading of a sitting, on leaf 173, is of 23 October 1780. The heading of its own sitting is on a page not among the scans.

translation.en:
On behalf of the Illustrious Zielonacki, Judge of the Kalisz Land Court, and [the Illustrious] Chełmski, against the Illustrious Prusimski and Bogdański — Report to the Tribunal

Let there be seen at this place, on behalf of the Illustrious Stefan Zielonacki, Judge of the Kalisz Land Court, and Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa,

text_english:
On behalf of the Illustrious Zielonacki, Judge of the Kalisz Land Court, and [the Illustrious] Chełmski, against the Illustrious Prusimski and Bogdański — Report to the Tribunal

Let there be seen at this place, on behalf of the Illustrious Stefan Zielonacki, Judge of the Kalisz Land Court, and Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa,
summary_en: An unfinished register note in the book of the castle court at Konin, 1780: the report of a citation before the Tribunal obtained by Stefan Zielonacki, judge of the Kalisz land court, and Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Prusimskis and the Bogdańskis. The note breaks off after the plaintiffs' names.
summary_de: Unvollendeter Registervermerk im Buch des Burggerichts Konin, 1780: Bericht über eine Ladung vor das Tribunal, erwirkt von Stefan Zielonacki, Richter des Kalischer Landgerichts, und Stanisław Chełmski, Schatzmeister von Wschowa, gegen die Prusimski und die Bogdański. Der Vermerk bricht nach den Namen der Kläger ab.
